opportunities.exact_claim: For any finite-dimensional possibly infinite state family E and one common EB Gamma with sup_E half trace error <= epsilon, a single classical experiment p_theta=Tr(M_z rho_theta) has optimal bounded [0,1]-loss Bayes risk R_Q<=R_C<=R_Q+epsilon for every finite prior and decision set. It preserves every exact matrix preparation identity and has all-priors classical capacity <= C(E).
opportunities.consequence: An equivalence-constrained [0,1]-score gap Delta against every unrestricted-alphabet classical encoding implies e>=Delta, and the supplied modulus implies b>=exp[-160000(C+1)/Delta^2].
opportunities.historical_importance: Experiment comparison and operational nonclassicality are foundational interfaces, but the explicit randomization implication and exact contextuality/broadcasting equivalence are established prior mechanisms.
opportunities.new_mechanism_scope: Composition of the supplied quantitative capacity/broadcasting modulus with one shared classical experiment and exact matrix equivalence constraints; no priority claim.
premises: Supplied internal candidate modulus for quantitative broadcasting consequence
Classical benchmark permits all latent alphabets and the constructed response rules
compatibility: Capacity in nats over all priors
No ordinary-decision converse to CPTP simulation
costs: Supplied state family and existence-level EB construction
K<=d^4 existential support; no capacity-only alphabet bound
opportunities.early_falsifier: Restricted operational equivalences need not be matrix identities; restrictions on the classical latent alphabet or effects agreeing only on E can exclude the constructed simulator.
opportunities.missing_lemma: None for the scoped forward transfer. A full robust subtheory characterization or a stronger norm statement would require additional arguments.

opportunities.exact_claim: For a supplied instrument L_a and initial rho0 whose full original reachable-state family E has one common EB reconstruction Gamma=RM with error epsilon, q0(z)=Tr(M_z rho0) and T(a,z'|z)=Tr(M_z' L_a(sigma_z)) define one fixed classical HMM with TV(P_n,Q_n)<=min(1,n epsilon) for all n. The uniform union over controlled original reachable families gives the same result for classical feedback policies.
opportunities.counterexample: For every multiple-of-eight N, a stationary periodic commuting instrument of dimension N+2 with output alphabet binom(N,N/2)+N+1 has reachable all-priors capacity exactly ln4 and b=0. Every exact classical HMM has intermediate memory entropy >=ln3+lnN/3, attained by the basis HMM. TV<=1/192 of its two-output law forces K >= [(1-h2(1/4))N ln2-ln(2(N+1))]/ln9. TV<=1/384 forces H(pi)>=(1/384)ln(L_N/2) when L_N>2.
opportunities.decisive_transfer_lemma: Hybrid replacement only invokes Gamma's error on original prefix states, never on modified reachable states. For the resource gate, balanced incidence has I(S;i)=ln2 but Wyner common information exactly lnN; support counting, simplex packing, and entropy truncation give exact and robust lower bounds.
opportunities.historical_importance: Predictive memory and latent realization complexity are important; common information and nonnegative rank already provide the relevant classical obstruction framework.
premises: E includes rho0 and every original positive-probability history state
One shared EB map for the entire E
Optional supplied modulus only for quantitative b,C composition; counterexample independent of it
compatibility: Statewise promise suffices for classical output laws
No condition that modified states remain E
All-priors capacity, not only the stationary ensemble
Arbitrary nonunifilar HMMs included in lower bound
costs: Horizon error accumulates as n epsilon
Fixed kernel entries require instrument and EB decomposition
Counterexample charges exponential output alphabet and periodicity
Exact HMM entropy grows with lnN even at C=ln4,b=0
No quantum memory advantage asserted by the commuting example
opportunities.early_falsifier: The capacity-only small-memory conjecture is explicitly false even at b=0 and stationarity. A policy-specific or per-history EB map also fails to furnish the claimed common kernel.
opportunities.missing_lemma: None for finite-horizon transfer or stated resource counterexamples. A useful small-memory acquisition theorem needs additional, presently unsupplied control of latent conditional-product complexity and acquisition.
opportunities.finite_diagnostics: PASS N=8,16; noncommuting reset horizons1..7; no general proof certification

overall_decision: Scoped positive operational transfers plus decisive negative resource gate; no foundational breakthrough designation.
